name: Benchmark generator for multiple sequence alignments and phylogenetics
description: A method/tool to generate benchmark datasets for evaluating multiple sequence alignment algorithms and phylogenetic reconstruction approaches.
evaluation_method: alignment/tree distance and accuracy metrics (e.g., SP-score, TC-score for alignments; Robinson–Foulds distance for trees)
general_score_metric: SP-score / TC-score for alignments; Robinson–Foulds distance for phylogenies
reputation: Widely used approach in bioinformatics research for producing controlled, simulated benchmarks to evaluate aligners and tree reconstruction methods.
notes: Synthetic benchmarks allow controlled evaluation but may not capture full biological complexity; results depend on simulator parameters. Non-LLM benchmark; care needed when extrapolating to real datasets.
